description: This file defines the ADODB_Pager class, which provides recordset pagination with navigation links, including methods for rendering pagination controls and grid display.

classes.name: ADODB_Pager
classes.description: A PHP class for paginating database recordsets with navigation controls and grid display.

methods.name: ADODB_Pager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pager with database connection, SQL, and configuration.

methods.name: Render_First
methods.description: Render link to the first page.

methods.name: render_next
methods.description: Render link to the next page.

methods.name: render_last
methods.description: Render link to the last page.

methods.name: render_pagelinks
methods.description: Render page number links for navigation.

methods.name: render_prev
methods.description: Render link to the previous page.

methods.name: RenderGrid
methods.description: Render the recordset as an HTML grid.

methods.name: RenderNav
methods.description: Render the navigation bar with pagination controls.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to execute query and render the paginated grid with controls.

methods.name: RenderLayout
methods.description: Render the overall layout including header, grid, and footer.
